source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: the C3A4 unit test (core-ar2 0.3), recorded in rytm2_mods euclid-accents/README.md at afd461d
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74, 2026-10-20, C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports): euclid-accents 1.1's test steps 1 to 4 pass. OP turns past SUB to OR*, XOR*, AND* and SUB*; with OR* only grid trigs play and those on euclid hits are accented; FUNC + EUC off writes the accents into the pattern; with an accent operator EUC stays on and the track plays only its grid trigs, and a plain operator brings euclid's trigs back. OP keeps its accent value through a power-cycle without SAVE PROJECT.
scope: euclid-accents 1.1 beside other rytm2_mods ports, never alone. No build with the released core-ar2 0.3 has run on a unit with it yet.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: OP keeps its accent value through a power-cycle without SAVE PROJECT.

individualTestResults: OP reaches OR*, XOR*, AND*, SUB*
Only grid trigs play; those on euclid hits accented
FUNC + EUC off bakes the accents

contextNote: Main OS hashes are the builds', not read back from the device. Modwerk links the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…, with #153), which differs from C3A4's core.
